choices: Focused on one concern with a diff you can understand
As large as possible so you only review once
items.explain: Small, single-purpose PRs are easier to review correctly.

items.prompt: RTL or TB changes should include…
choices: Test or simulation evidence (how you verified)
Only a wave dump in the repo
items.explain: Reviewers need proof the change was exercised—sim, TB, or CI.

items.prompt: Build artifacts like .vcd files and sim logs should not appear in a PR diff.
items.explain: Diff hygiene keeps generated noise and secrets out of version control.

items.prompt: If a PR leaks a secret token, you should…
items.explain: Secrets in a diff are a blocking issue regardless of other quality.
